summary: This note describes Zarqa Governorate, a governorate in Jordan. It gives the Arabic name and local dialect names, and says the governorate is the third largest in Jordan by population. It identifies Zarqa City as the capital and largest city, located east of Amman, with Russeifa as the second largest city.
one_line: Zarqa Governorate is Jordan's third largest governorate by population, with Zarqa City as its capital and largest city, east of Amman.
key_facts: Zarqa Governorate is the third largest governorate in Jordan by population.
The Arabic name of Zarqa Governorate is "محافظة الزرقاء", transliterated Muħāfazat az-Zarqāʔ.
Local dialects call Zarqa Governorate "ez-Zergā" or "ez-Zer'a".
The capital of Zarqa Governorate is Zarqa City.
Zarqa City is the largest city in Zarqa Governorate.
Zarqa Governorate is located east of the Jordanian capital Amman.
The second largest city in Zarqa Governorate is Russeifa.
